summary: The customer called in frustrated after a long hold time because their new router was showing a blinking red light and failing to connect. The agent tried troubleshooting steps including checking power connections and testing the line, but after the hard reset failed, the customer demanded to cancel their service. The agent offered to escalate to a senior technician and provide a free replacement router.
